components.css: .ds-artifact { align-items:center; display:grid; gap:4rem; grid-template-columns:1.35fr .65fr; margin:0; } .ds-artifact-preview { aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#0e1117; border:1px solid rgba(199,207,255,.13); border-radius:14px; } .ds-artifact figcaption { display:grid; gap:.75rem; } .ds-artifact small { color:#8b91ff; font:500 .75rem Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-artifact strong { color:#f3f4f7; font:560 2rem/1.1 Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-artifact span { color:#a9afbd; font:400 .9375rem/1.65 Manrope,sans-serif; } @media(max-width:900px){.ds-artifact{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem;}}

narrative.overview: The portfolio treats Anthony's work as a precise, evolving record rather than a promotional spectacle. Graphite surfaces recede, evidence stays in the foreground, and small pieces of release-style metadata give the page an engineering character without turning code aesthetics into a costume. The system is calm, exact, and technically credible. A sparse constellation layer connects it to the landing experience, while the post-landing interface refuses oversized portfolio typography, decorative logo clouds, overlapping white showcase cards, and theatrical scroll motion.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led ledgers instead of résumé cards.
Warm-white hierarchy on layered graphite surfaces.
Faint constellation geometry used only as connective atmosphere.
Short, accessible state transitions with reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet Status is rare enough that every use communicates navigation, focus, or identity.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: No text grows merely to create excitement; the work artifact is allowed to become the focal point.

rules.name: The Natural Flow Rule
rules.body: Do not use translated layouts, desktop minimum widths, fixed mobile content heights, or overflow as a compositional technique.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Content earns prominence through scale, placement, and contrast—not simulated elevation.

dos: Do lead sections with factual work, roles, screenshots, or decisions.
Do keep body copy left-aligned and within a readable measure.
Do preserve the single Warm White → Cool Steel → Slate Metadata hierarchy.
Do use Violet Status only for identity, focus, navigation, or state.
Do keep content mounted and useful before below-fold images finish loading.
Do preserve semantic headings, landmarks, lists, image alternatives, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't bring back centered oversized headings, justified paragraphs, logo clouds, or floating white cards.
Don't use fixed content heights, translated layout offsets, or minimum widths that can overflow the viewport.
Don't add gradients, glass, glow, or monospace styling as shorthand for technology.
Don't animate every section; the post-landing entrance is the single authored reveal.
Don't fabricate metrics, testimonials, contact details, or project outcomes.
